market_summary: S&P 500 +1.6% and Nasdaq +2.3% in Friday's half-day session, led by chips: MU and MRVL both +7%. GPU rents held (H100 $3.07/hr, B200 $7.02/hr); DRAM spot slipped again. Neocloud credit is still the weak leg. Fed decision Dec 9 (hike expected), with Marvell earnings and AWS re:Invent first, on Tue Dec 1.

AMZN.reason: +4.0% Friday as megacaps rebounded on Black Friday. No company news since Nov 26.

AXOS.reason: +1.2% Friday. Cheap at about 9x forward. No news since Nov 26.

BABA.reason: +4.1% Friday on the tech rebound. Forward PE around 10. No new company news.

ENPH.reason: +3.8% Friday in a broad risk-on session. No company news. Still a turnaround story.

GOOGL.reason: +0.7% Friday, behind the Nasdaq's +2.3%. No new company news.

LDI.reason: +2.9% Friday on light volume. No forward PE is available. Mortgage rates are elevated with the 10-year near 4.9%.

META.reason: +3.3% Friday as AI names bounced. No company news since Nov 26.

MRVL.reason: +7.4% Friday, among the strongest chip names as AI-profitability worries eased.

MU.reason: +7.3% Friday, leading the semiconductor rebound. The forward PE of about 4 implies a steep jump in earnings.

NVDA.reason: +0.8% Friday, lagging the chip rebound. Volatile after Huang's return as CEO; reports say S&P Global put the credit rating on negative watch over governance.

RKT.reason: -1.4% Friday, one of the few decliners. The 10-year yield near 4.9% and talk of Fed hikes weigh on mortgage names.

TSM.reason: +3.3% Friday as the chip rally broadened. No new company news.

STRIPE.reason: No new valuation mark or tender found since Nov 26.

OPENAI.reason: No new valuation mark or tender found since Nov 26.

headlines: Chips led a Black Friday bounce: MU +7.3%, MRVL +7.4%, Nasdaq +2.3% in the half day.
Every holding but RKT rose Friday; AMZN +4.0%, BABA +4.1%, NVDA lagged at +0.8%.
GPU rents steady: H100 $3.07/hr, B200 $7.02/hr; DRAM spot down on all four lines.
Marvell Q3 Tue Dec 1 after US close = Wed 8:30am AEDT; AWS re:Invent keynote same day.
Fed decision Dec 9 = Thu Dec 10 6am AEDT; a hike is expected.
